entries.zh: 对同；（同一位置处所）相互对应、彼此一致
entries.en: to correspond with one another in the position of the place; to match, agree (in location)

entries.zh: 滩；急流、险滩（湍急的水流）
entries.en: a furious, raging current; rapids, swift water over a shoal

entries.zh: 湃（字栏疑为“汹/湃”）；水势汹涌澎湃，急流奔腾
entries.en: surging, turbulent (of water); character doubtful (汹/湃), sense 'surging and roaring'
entries.notes: 字栏[疑:汹/湃]，取“澎湃汹涌”义以合词头与上下文。

entries.zh: 势；水势（湍急的水势）
entries.en: force, impetus; the rush and violence of the current

entries.zh: 涌；（水流）涌起、腾涌
entries.en: to surge, well up, gush (of water)

entries.zh: 流头；水流（水流行经之处）
entries.en: a current; the flow, the course where the water runs

entries.zh: 水流涌；水流涌动（涌起的水流）
entries.en: flowing water surging; the current welling up

entries.zh: 流水；流动之水
entries.en: flowing, running water

entries.zh: 流水透；急水穿流（流水湍急而过）
entries.en: swift flowing water; the current rushing through
entries.notes: “透”在此短语中的确切义（贯通/湍急）依赖推断；字栏与对音本身清晰。

entries.zh: 水大涨而流急（字栏两字存疑，据对音推读近“大水紧”）
entries.en: a big, fast-rushing current (characters doubtful; probably 'the floodwater rises high and runs swift')
entries.notes: 字栏两处[疑:隹/佳][疑:繁/系]，释义据对音推读为“大水紧”。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: [Original damaged/illegible; gloss uncertain.]

entries.zh: 流水宽；水势宽缓（平缓的水流）
entries.en: a gentle, slack current; water flowing wide and slow

entries.zh: （食物等）腐坏、变质，烂掉（字栏疑为“擥/攬”，当记闽南语“爁”之腐坏义）
entries.en: to spoil, go bad, rot (of food/things)
entries.notes: 字栏[疑:擥/攬]；据闽南语“爁”之腐坏义释之，与词头“腐坏”相合。

entries.zh: 烂；腐烂、腐坏
entries.en: rotten, decayed; to rot

entries.zh: 短；短少、不够长
entries.en: short (in length); headword 'Cortacosta' obscure, probably 'squat, short-cut'
entries.notes: 词头 Cortacosta 17 世纪义不明；中文与官话栏明确为“短”。

entries.zh: 铰、剪断（字栏疑为“鉗/鉸”，依对音当为“铰”）
entries.en: to cut (with shears or scissors-like tool)
entries.notes: 字栏[疑:鉗/鉸]，依对音取“铰”之剪裁义，合词头 Cortar。

entries.zh: 剪；用剪刀剪
entries.en: to cut with scissors, to snip

entries.zh: 割；切开、割断（音栏后半原件残损）
entries.en: to cut, to sever (a following syllable in the original is damaged/illegible)
entries.notes: M 栏注[残]且有 T99 污损，仅“割”一字可辨。

entries.zh: 绝；截断、断绝（词头与音栏污损难辨）
entries.en: to cut off, sever, interrupt (headword and phonetics corrupted/illegible)
entries.notes: 词头文字混乱且 M/R 均有 T99 污损，取“绝”之截断义。

entries.zh: 伐；砍伐（树木）
entries.en: to fell, to cut down (trees); to cut
entries.notes: R 栏声调标记 T99 污损，依例降置信；字义本身明确。

entries.zh: 分；分开、分切
entries.en: to divide, to split, to cut apart
entries.notes: M/R 声调标记均 T99 污损，依例降置信；字义本身明确。

entries.zh: 砍；砍伐（树木）
entries.en: to hack, to chop down (trees)
entries.notes: 词头内混入另段音写文字，M/R 声调标记均 T99 污损，依例降置信。
